solutions.explanation:
The five small combination numbers can be evaluated directly. The combination formula gives \(C(4,0)=1\), \(C(4,1)=4\), \(C(4,2)=\frac{4\cdot3}{2\cdot1}=6\), \(C(4,3)=4\), and \(C(4,4)=1\). Adding these values gives
\[
1+4+6+4+1=16.
\]
solutions.title: Evaluate the combination numbers
